snippet.title: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466060/Tainted_Grail_The_Fall_of_Avalon/
Song: "Otar the Foul" by EPÏKUS
Watch the official release date trailer for Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon, a true open-world, dark fantasy RPG, reimagining the Arthurian legends.
Coming to PC and consoles on May 23, 2025, at 17:00 CET!
